conclusion: batch_size=1 caused all 3 smoke-suite decodes to hit the 24s decode-timeout budget (decode_timeout_count=3), producing no comparable metrics against the batch_size=2 control (which decoded normally, parse_rate=1.0, p50=2646.91ms). Not yet a confirmed harness defect (single occurrence) but a real, reproducible-looking regression worth re-testing before batch_size=1 is used in any continuous cycle.
next_priorities: infrastructure: re-run batch_size=1 in isolation (steps=40, same eval_version) to confirm the decode-timeout-count=3 result reproduces before treating it as a harness signal
model: revisit smaller batch sizes only after the timeout cause is understood -- do not conclude batch_size=1 is slower on latency alone, since it never produced a measurable decode this cycle
evaluation: fixture insufficient_n (n=3 < 20) on both smoke and held_out remains an expected, non-terminal diagnostic at wf_smoke_v2 scale
